title: Pipelines Module
summary: The pipelines module provides high-level, ready-to-use abstractions for various NLP, vision, and audio tasks, simplifying model inference and data processing for end-users.

nodes.label: Automatic Speech Recognition Pipeline
nodes.title: Automatic Speech Recognition Pipeline
nodes.description: Transcribes spoken audio into text, supporting various audio formats and models like Whisper, CTC, and seq2seq.

nodes.label: Document Question Answering Pipeline
nodes.title: Document Question Answering Pipeline
nodes.description: Answers questions based on document images, optionally performing OCR to extract text and bounding boxes.

nodes.label: Image-Text-to-Text Pipeline
nodes.title: Image-Text-to-Text Pipeline
nodes.description: Generates text from image and text inputs, supporting conversational models and various input formats.

nodes.label: Chunk Pipeline
nodes.title: Chunk Pipeline Base Class
nodes.description: A base class for pipelines that process inputs in chunks, managing preprocessing, forwarding, and postprocessing steps.

nodes.label: CLI Tools
nodes.title: CLI Tools
nodes.description: Provides command-line interface utilities for interacting with Hugging Face Transformers functionalities, such as serving models.

nodes.label: Model Architectures
nodes.title: Model Architectures
nodes.description: Defines the various model architectures available in the library, including text, vision, and audio models.

nodes.label: Data Processing
nodes.title: Data Processing
nodes.description: Handles the preprocessing and postprocessing of data for different modalities, including tokenization, feature extraction, and image manipulation.

groups.label: Pipeline Implementations
groups.title: Specific Pipeline Implementations
groups.description: Concrete pipeline classes for various tasks, built upon the base Pipeline and ChunkPipeline classes.

groups.label: Pipeline Foundations
groups.title: Core Pipeline Infrastructure
groups.description: Base classes and utilities that provide the fundamental structure and common functionalities for all pipelines.
